employ a method: The teacher decided to employ a method that uses games to help students remember new words.
老師決定採用一種利用遊戲幫助學生記住新單字的方法。
employ force: The police were told not to employ force unless the protesters became violent.
警方被告知除非抗議者變得暴力，否則不得使用武力。
employ one's skills: In her new job as a designer, she can employ her skills in drawing and photography every day.
在她擔任設計師的新工作中，她每天都能運用自己繪畫和攝影的技能。
be employed as: She was employed as a nurse at the city hospital for ten years, often working night shifts.
她受雇為市立醫院的護理師長達十年，經常上夜班。
empty promises: Voters are tired of politicians who make empty promises before elections and forget them afterward.
選民厭倦了那些在選前開出空洞承諾、選後就忘得一乾二淨的政治人物。
empty one's mind: Before sleeping, try to close your eyes, breathe slowly, and empty your mind of all worries.
睡前試著閉上眼睛、慢慢呼吸，把腦中的煩惱全部放空。
the room emptied: As soon as the bell rang, the room emptied, and only the teacher was left at her desk.
鐘聲一響，教室裡的人就走光了，只剩老師坐在她的桌前。
empty the trash: It's your turn to empty the trash, so please take it outside before the garbage truck comes.
輪到你倒垃圾了，所以請在垃圾車來之前把它拿出去。
enable growth: Lower taxes for small businesses will enable growth by giving owners more money to hire workers.
降低小型企業的稅金將讓老闆有更多錢僱用員工，從而促成成長。
enable students to learn: Online videos enable students to learn at their own speed, even when they are at home.
線上影片使學生得以依照自己的速度學習，即使是在家裡也可以。
enable a feature: To protect your account, you should enable a feature that sends a code to your phone every time you log in.
為了保護你的帳號，你應該啟用一項功能，讓每次登入時都會傳送驗證碼到你的手機。
enclose a check: Please enclose a check with your application form if you want to join the summer camp.
如果你想參加夏令營，請在申請表中隨信附上支票。
enclosed by walls: The old garden is enclosed by high stone walls, so nobody on the street can see inside.
這座老花園被高高的石牆圍住，所以街上的人都看不到裡面。
please find enclosed: Thank you for your interest in our company; please find enclosed a list of our prices for this year.
感謝您對本公司的關注；請見附件中我們今年的價目表。
encounter problems: If you encounter problems with the new software, please call our help desk for support.
如果你在使用新軟體時遇到問題，請打電話給我們的服務台尋求協助。
encounter resistance: The plan to build a factory near the river may encounter resistance from local residents.
在河邊蓋工廠的計畫可能會遭遇當地居民的阻力。
encounter difficulties: Many students encounter difficulties when they first try to write long essays in English.
許多學生第一次嘗試用英文寫長篇作文時都會碰到困難。
a chance encounter: A chance encounter with an old friend at the train station made her whole day much happier.
在火車站和老朋友的一次偶遇，讓她一整天都開心了許多。
endanger lives: Drivers who use their phones while driving endanger lives, both their own and other people's.
開車時使用手機的駕駛人會危及性命，包括他們自己和其他人的性命。
endanger health: Smoking can seriously endanger health, not only yours but also that of the people around you.
抽菸會嚴重危害健康，不只是你自己的，也包括你身邊的人。
endangered species: The panda was once an endangered species, but its numbers have grown thanks to protection programs.
貓熊曾經是瀕危物種，但多虧了保育計畫，牠們的數量已經增加了。
endorse a product: Many famous athletes are paid millions of dollars to endorse a product on TV and social media.
許多知名運動員獲得數百萬美元的酬勞，在電視和社群媒體上代言產品。
endorse a candidate: The popular mayor decided to publicly endorse a candidate in the election, which helped her win many votes.
這位受歡迎的市長決定在選舉中公開支持一位候選人，這幫助她贏得了許多選票。
endorse a view: Most parents endorse a view shared by many doctors: children need at least nine hours of sleep every night.
大多數家長贊同許多醫生共有的看法：孩子每晚至少需要九小時的睡眠。
endorse a check: You must endorse a check by signing your name on the back before the bank will accept it.
你必須在支票背面簽名背書，銀行才會接受它。
endure pain: The injured runner had to endure pain for the last kilometer, but he still finished the race.
受傷的跑者在最後一公里必須忍受痛苦，但他仍然跑完了比賽。
endure hardship: Our grandparents had to endure hardship during the war, often without enough food to eat.
我們的祖父母在戰爭期間必須熬過困苦，常常沒有足夠的食物可吃。
his fame endures: Although the singer died fifty years ago, his fame endures, and young people today still sing his songs.
雖然這位歌手五十年前就過世了，但他聲名不墜，現在的年輕人仍然在唱他的歌。
endure the test of time: True friendships endure the test of time, even when friends live in different countries for years.
真正的友誼能歷久不衰，即使朋友們多年來住在不同的國家。
